# Python support matrix

The current profile support and alpha.4 structure boundaries are documented in `../docs/SUPPORT-MATRIX.md`.

Primary support includes ordinary pure-Python libraries, CLIs, applications/services, asyncio, pyproject-based distributions, optional static typing, runtime validation, and sdist/wheel subjects.

Multiprocessing, plugins, migrations, free-threaded CPython, native extensions, public stub packages, and web/hypermedia systems are conditional and require their applicable review packs and evidence.

Embedded/mobile/WASM/GPU Python, undeclared alternative interpreters, complex scientific native stacks, and operating-system vendor packaging remain partial or unqualified.
